meta.title: Volleyball on Saturday
meta.textType: dialogue: where and when to meet

paragraphs: It was Wednesday, and school was finished for the day. Lily, Mia, and Leo sat at the bottom of the library steps. Mia had a big book about skyscrapers. "This book is very interesting," she said. Leo opened his bag and showed his new volleyball. "My dad gave it to me," he said. "Let's play on Saturday," said Lily. "Where shall we meet?" asked Mia. "And what time?" asked Leo.

"Let's meet at the school field," said Lily. "No, the field is full in the morning," said Leo. "Coach Matt has football there from nine o'clock to eleven o'clock." "Then we can play after eleven," said Mia. "I can't come before eleven," said Lily. "On Saturday morning I go to the market with Mom. We come home at half past ten." "Let's meet at the bottom of the library steps at eleven," said Mia. "We can walk to the field together."

Mia took a pencil and a paper. She wrote, "Saturday, library steps, eleven o'clock." "Someone must bring water," said Lily. "I will bring it," said Mia. "Someone must tell Tom and Ben," said Leo. "I will ask Tom at dinner," said Lily. That evening, Lily sat next to Tom and told him the plan. "Can you and Ben come on Saturday?" she asked. "Ben and I play football with Coach Matt until eleven o'clock," said Tom. "Then we can be at the field at half past eleven." "Good!" said Lily.

On Saturday, Lily came home from the market at half past ten. At eleven o'clock, she and Pip were at the bottom of the library steps. Mia and Leo were there, and Mia had water. They walked to the field together. Leo played well, and Mia played well too. At half past eleven, Tom and Ben came across the field. "Are we late?" asked Ben. "No, you are on time," said Lily. Pip ran after the ball and brought it back to Leo. Everyone laughed, and the friends played together until lunch. A good plan makes a good Saturday.
text.summary: Lily, Mia, and Leo make a plan to play volleyball on Saturday. They choose the place and the time, and they ask Tom and Ben to come.
